assumptions.hour_convention: HOUR 01 -> 00:00 same date, HOUR 24 -> 23:00 same date - unverified working assumption
assumptions.bin_convention: hourly bins [h, h+1); observation timestamp is the assumed interval start
assumptions.baseline_rule: 24 h and 48 h before/after windows; a window is full if all raw bins are free, reduced if >= 12 free bins (MIN_BASELINE_FREE_HOURS) but not all, otherwise excluded
assumptions.48h_comparison_rule: window_48h_full_only keeps only events whose before AND after 48 h windows are both full
